body.content: Cross-validation summary: four independent methods (positional product 9*9*8=648, complement from 900 via PIE = 648, case split on zero presence = 144+504=648, per-hundred-block summation = 9*72=648) all agree on 648. The rival 504 arises from the well-known misreading 'all digits nonzero' instead of 'hundreds digit nonzero, all three pairwise distinct.' The rival 612 appears unmotivated; one possible origin is subtracting half the zero-in-tens count from 648, but this has no principled basis.
body.possible_next_move: If any neighborhood artifact claims a count other than 648, challenge it by asking for the explicit positional counting rule or PIE calculation; if it produces 504 or 612, identify the misreading.
body.why_keep_this: Documents the convergence of multiple independent mechanisms on 648 and traces the origins of rival counts to specific errors, enabling robust falsification of alternatives.

body.content: Exploring the neighborhood consensus: SRC_005, SRC_006, SRC_007 all claim 648. SRC_008 claims 504.
